title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
abstract: arXiv:2608.18486v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with connection weights that can vary across consumer layers and adapt to the source token. For each token, a router implements these connections by mixing its $L$ layer states into $k$ KV channels that are cached for subsequent tokens; each consumer layer attends to one of the channels. translated_title: 白质：通过KV混合实现的全对全跨层连接
translated_abstract: 在Transformer中，每一层仅通过其自身深度产生的KV（键值）来关注过去的令牌，尽管在自回归解码过程中存在更深的表示。反馈架构允许浅层消费者层关注由更深过去令牌表示产生的KV，但给所有消费者层相同的固定连接模式到源层。我们提出白质（WhiteMatter），它将每个注意力层连接到每个过去令牌的所有层的表示，连接权重可以随消费者层变化并适应源令牌。对于每个令牌，路由器通过将其L层状态混合到k个KV通道中来实现这些连接，这些通道被缓存以供后续令牌使用；每个消费者层关注其中一个通道。通道数量k控制KV缓存大小。设置k<L可减少缓存的内存占用。在我们的预训练实验中，白质优于普通Transformer。
tldr: 白质提出了一种全对全跨层连接机制，通过路由器将每层的KV混合成可配置数量的通道，实现层间动态连接并减少KV缓存内存。
en_tdlr: WhiteMatter introduces an all-to-all cross-layer connection mechanism that mixes layer-wise KV states into configurable channels via a router, enabling dynamic inter-layer connectivity while reducing KV cache memory.
